title: Source Quality Audit smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Source Quality Audit craftbook: five roster sources against a month of briefs in which The Daily Splash caused two corrections and Materials Weekly never appeared — the verdict table covers all five with evidence.
prompt: the brief has felt noisy latly — can you audit the sources this month and tell me what to drop?

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for source-quality-audit. The source roster is seeded at sources.json and the month's briefs sit under briefs/ as the evidence base; the deliverable is tasks/eval/report.md with the verdict table.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Source Quality Audit craftbook/template, score every roster source against the month's briefs only, and write tasks/eval/report.md. No live feeds, services, or outside data — the seeded briefs are the whole record.

files.content:
# Morning brief - 2026-06-05

## Municipal Broadband
- Council schedules the broadband vote for July. (Newsline)
- The Daily Splash claims the depot fiber build cut program costs 40%. (The Daily Splash)

## Battery Recycling
- Spring collection pilot wraps with volumes above plan. (Harbor Bulletin)

# Morning brief - 2026-06-12

## Municipal Broadband
- Correction: the 40% cost figure The Daily Splash ran last week was wrong - the county puts the saving at 14%. (Harbor Bulletin)
- State fiber office publishes the pilot application checklist. (Capitol Wire)

## Battery Recycling
- Port recycler files for the second-life pack permit. (Harbor Bulletin)

# Morning brief - 2026-06-19

## Municipal Broadband
- Newsline breaks the story: the cost study's consultant missed two substations, delaying the vote. (Newsline)
- The Daily Splash reported the Westport plant had closed; the plant says otherwise - treating as retracted. (The Daily Splash)

## Battery Recycling
- Fire marshal opens comment period on depot storage rules. (Capitol Wire)

# Morning brief - 2026-06-26

## Municipal Broadband
- Council staff confirm the revised cost study lands mid-July. (Newsline)

## Battery Recycling
- Weekend depots extend hours for the summer. (Harbor Bulletin)
- The Daily Splash runs six items on a viral battery-fire video; none add facts beyond the original report. (The Daily Splash)

success.summary: tasks/eval/report.md carries a verdict table covering all five roster sources, verdicts from the fixed set with cited evidence: The Daily Splash's corrections and Materials Weekly's silence both show up in their rows.

checks.label: verdicts use the fixed set — keep
verdicts use the fixed set — drop
every roster source covered — Capitol Wire
every roster source covered — Harbor Bulletin
every roster source covered — The Daily Splash
every roster source covered — Materials Weekly

checks.rubric: Every verdict cites at least one concrete example from the month's briefs or explicitly notes the source went unused. The Daily Splash's repeated corrections and Materials Weekly's total silence are both reflected in their verdicts.
checks.label: verdicts earn their evidence

axes.name: evidence
axes.description: Every verdict is backed by concrete examples from the briefs — items delivered, corrections caused, or documented silence.

axes.name: fairness
axes.description: Sources are judged on the record, not vibes; a noisy source's genuine contributions still count.

axes.name: decisiveness
axes.description: Verdicts come from the fixed set (keep, demote, drop) and the closing changes list matches them.

axes.name: hygiene
axes.description: The report notes what dropping a source leaves uncovered and what might fill the gap.
